verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents COPY INTO, stages and file formats as its ingestion path, along with SQL for bulk copying data into tables. Snowpipe docs describe loading staged files as an automated alternative to manually running COPY statements. A hands-on user confirms the COPY command loads many JSON Lines files straight from a bucket and skips files already loaded. Missing for 10: explicit evidence naming CSV and Parquet as supported formats, and first-party detail on COPY INTO syntax for external cloud stages (S3/GCS/Azure).
